== Biography ==
Edward Glasgow is named as father of Latouche Edward William Glasgow, christened on 18 May 1825 at Saint Mary Magdalene,Bermondsey,London,England; the other parent is Emily Caroline.<ref name="anc145077998">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/145077998 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, Edward Glasgow, 18 May 1825, Saint Mary Magdalene,Bermondsey,London,England]. Ancestry index transcript inspected 2026-11-05; original source uninspected.</ref>

Edward George Glasgow is named as father of Edward William Morris Glasgow, christened on 24 Feb 1828 at Saint James The Apostle,Dover,Kent,England; the other parent is Emily Caroline. This entry is attributed to the same person as a consolidated, compatible record (father of Edward William Morris Glasgow).<ref name="anc122874989">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/122874989 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, Edward George Glasgow, 24 Feb 1828, Saint James The Apostle,Dover,Kent,England]. Index entry read 2026-11-05; original uninspected.</ref>

Edward Glasgow is indexed as a parent of Latouche Edward William Glasgow; the other parent is Emily Caroline. This entry is attributed to the same person as a consolidated, compatible record (father of Latouche Edward William Glasgow).<ref name="anc145077996">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/145077996 Ancestry, England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975, Edward Glasgow]. Index entry read 2026-11-05; original uninspected.</ref>

Edward George Glasgow married Emily Caroline Medlicott on 23 Sep 1823. This entry is attributed to the same person as a consolidated, compatible record (groom).<ref name="anc362920">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60931/records/362920 Ancestry, UK, British Army and Navy Birth, Marriage and Death Records, 1730-1960, Edward Glasgow, 23 Sep 1823]. Index entry read 2026-11-05; original uninspected.</ref>

=== Possible artillery family ===
Edward George, husband of Emily Caroline Medlicott, is a possible son of General George Glasgow, assessed at 55%. The compiled Glasgow–Green family lists an Edward George at Quebec in 1794 alongside George Mark in 1795. George Mark’s independent obituary identifies his father as the late General Glasgow of the same artillery corps. The held OCR of The Spectator, 1 March 1851, calls George Mark a son of the late General Glasgow of the same corps.<ref>[https://archive.org/details/sim_spectator-uk_1851-03-01_24_1183 The Spectator, 1 March 1851, deaths column], held OCR reading; original page not inspected in this review.</ref> The two sons’ unusual full names and Quebec setting favour this family over an unspecified London parent. The compiled child’s identification with the adult husband remains unproved. No maternal identity or merger with the separate 1843 death account is assigned.<ref>[https://www.oocities.org/Athens/7734/dat28.htm#4 Compiled Glasgow–Green family], unsourced compilation; [https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/D199415 The National Archives, will catalogue D199415, PROB11/1637/234], original will uninspected.</ref>
